about: AI image models for thumbnail backgrounds, scenes and props (never faces of the user, never text: those are set in code). None is enabled here. Turn one on in data/craft/image-models.json, for example {"models":[{"id":"flux-schnell-local","enabled":true}]}. Placeholders: {prompt} {out} {width} {height} {seed} {app}. The command runs without a shell, from the app folder. See docs/thumbnails-ai-images.md.

models.name: FLUX.1 schnell on this computer (diffusers)
models.needs: An NVIDIA GPU with 12 GB or more (runs on 8 GB with --offload, slowly), about 35 GB of disk for the weights on first run.
models.about: Apache-2.0 model, 4 steps, good for backgrounds and props.

models.name: FLUX.1 dev on this computer (diffusers)
models.needs: Accept the licence on the model's Hugging Face page and set HF_TOKEN. 16 GB VRAM, or 12 GB with --offload.
models.price: free after the download (non-commercial licence for the weights; read it)

models.name: FLUX through a running ComfyUI
models.needs: ComfyUI running on 127.0.0.1:8188 with a FLUX checkpoint (set COMFYUI_URL to use another address).
models.about: Talks to ComfyUI's HTTP API; works with full checkpoints or GGUF quantized models (--gguf).

models.name: FLUX.1 schnell on Replicate
models.about: Fast and cheap; fine for backgrounds.

models.name: OpenAI gpt-image-1
models.about: Follows long prompts well; makes 1536x1024 and is cropped to 16:9.
